hero.title: Skate 3 Browser Game
hero.description: Yes, you really can play Skate 3 in a web browser. In October 2026 an 18-year-old student made it work: a browser-hosted port built on a Chrome-compatible RPCS3 (PS3 emulator) core that runs the full Skate 3 game engine — no download, no console, no streaming, on almost any device. Alongside it there's the official route: Xbox Cloud Gaming streams Skate 3 through your browser with a Game Pass subscription. This wiki covers both roads to the skatepark: step-by-step play guides, controls, system requirements, the technology behind the port, and how the browser version compares to running RPCS3 yourself.

aboutGame.title: What Is the Skate 3 Browser Game?
paragraphs: The Skate 3 Browser Game is 2026's most delightful gaming plot twist: an 18-year-old student figured out how to host EA's 2010 skateboarding classic through a web browser, using a Chrome-compatible build of RPCS3 — the open-source PlayStation 3 emulator — to run the actual game engine client-side rather than streaming video. The result works on almost any device with a browser: laptops, Chromebooks, phones, the lot. No download, no install, no console. Press coverage in October 2026 introduced it to the world, and the search for a way to play Skate 3 in a browser has been climbing steadily since.

There are two honest ways into this skatepark, and this wiki documents both. The unofficial web port: free, instant, community-built — a marvel of emulation engineering with the quirks that implies. The official route: Xbox Cloud Gaming streams Skate 3 through your browser as part of a Game Pass subscription — polished, legal, paid. Both get you to Port Carverton; the comparison page helps you choose, and the guides get you rolling either way.

items.question: Can you really play Skate 3 in a browser?
items.answer: Yes — as of October 2026 there are two ways. The unofficial web port runs the full game engine in your browser via a Chrome-compatible RPCS3 build, free and with no download. The official route streams Skate 3 through Xbox Cloud Gaming with a Game Pass subscription. Both work in a browser tab on almost any device.

items.question: Is the Skate 3 browser version free?
items.answer: The community web port is free. The official Xbox Cloud Gaming route requires an Xbox Game Pass subscription, though it often costs less than a month of coffee and streams the licensed game properly. The comparison page breaks down what each gets you.

items.question: Is the browser port the full game?
items.answer: The web port runs the full Skate 3 game engine — Port Carverton, the career mode, the tricks, all of it — rather than a stripped demo. It's a community project, so expect occasional quirks, but what's running is the real game.

items.question: Does it work on a Chromebook or phone?
items.answer: That's the port's party trick — because the heavy lifting happens through the browser-hosted engine and your device just needs a modern browser, it runs on hardware that could never install the original. Performance varies by device; the requirements page maps what to expect.
